sentence: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

sentence: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.

quote: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.

sentence: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA; or (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.

sentence: Method of measurement The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

sentence: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

sentence: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

sentence: Vehicles or components or ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7. above.

sentence: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).
text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
test_case: Measure broadband and narrowband emissions of a series ESA per Annexes 7/8 and confirm levels do not exceed the paragraph 6.5.2.1/6.6.2.1 limits by more than 4 dB.
quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. above for ESAs (as appropriate).

sentence: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above.
text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
test_case: Expose a series ESA to radiated fields up to 80 % of the paragraph 6.8.2.1 limits per Annex 9 and confirm no observable degradation of the lamp functions.
quote: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs above.

sentence: If the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1. above.
text: When the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.

quote: If the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1. above.

text: In the "Brake mode" vehicle test conditions, with the vehicle in a state that allows the braking system to operate normally, parking brake released, vehicle speed 0 km/h, and brake pedal depressed to activate the brake function and the stop lights without any dynamic cycle, stop lights inactivated during mode shall be considered a failure criterion.

sentence: Alternative measuring location As an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS), which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used (see Figure 1 of the appendix to this Annex).

quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines. sentence: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

sentence: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
test_case: Inspect the installed lamp after vibration exposure under normal conditions of use and verify that its photometric and geometric characteristics remain within the Regulation's limits.
quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

sentence: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

sentence: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

sentence: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.

quote: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

sentence: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle and only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.

sentence: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

text: For the visibility of a red lamp to the front and visibility of a white lamp to the rear (see paragraph 5.10.4.), in their respective planes, the zones 1 and 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in width by two vertical planes which, forming to the front and to the rear respectively an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, pass through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width, except that if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.

sentence: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.

sentence: If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.

sentence: Nature of tests Tests of conformity in this Regulation shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics.

sentence: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random: (a) No measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.

sentence: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.
text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 minute, after 10 minutes and after photometric stability has occurred.

quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV: (a) After 1 minute; (b) After 10 minutes; and (c) After photometric stability has occurred.

sentence: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
text: For all other lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.

sentence: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
text: For all other lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
test_case: Check that any calculated 1 min distribution uses the HV intensity ratio of 1 min to 30 min (or stabilisation) applied at each test point.
quote: The luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
test_case: Inspect the device drawing and sample to confirm a marking space large enough for the UI or the approval marking plus other markings per paragraph 3.3.4.2.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.

sentence: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.

quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.

sentence: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1. Examples of the arrangement of the markings are shown in Annex 10.

quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1. Examples of the arrangement of the markings are shown in Annex 10.

sentence: The approval marking shall consist of: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

quote: The approval marking shall consist of: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.

sentence: The approval marking shall consist of: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a four to six-digit sequential number matching the approval number per paragraph 3.2.3.2.
quote: The approval marking shall consist of: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.

sentence: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Inspect the marking layout to confirm the sequential number is located adjacent to the approval mark.
quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.

sentence: The approval marking shall consist of: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
test_case: Inspect the marking for the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) per Table 1 of paragraph 3.2.5.
quote: The approval marking shall consist of: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.

sentence: The approval marking shall consist of: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
test_case: Inspect the marking for "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments in force at the time of approval.
quote: The approval marking shall consist of: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.

sentence: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available. The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)
text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I Unique Identifier (UI).
condition: The Unique Identifier is used instead of the approval marking.

quote: The approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. may be replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available. The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below: Figure I Unique Identifier (UI)

sentence: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector; pass if the applicant's trade name or mark is present.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.

sentence: Retro-reflective devices shall bear in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective devices shall bear the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
condition: Retro-reflector class (IA/IB) and whether the angle of rotation needs a TOP indication are not confirmed.
test_case: Check whether the retro-reflector is rotation-sensitive; if so, verify 'TOP' is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear in case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.

sentence: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
test_case: Visually inspect the device; pass if approval mark/UI, trade name and any TOP marking are clearly legible.
quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.

sentence: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed. This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that:
text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed, and this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.6.1.1. and 3.3.6.1.2. are met.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined rear lamp and retro-reflector.
test_case: Review marking arrangement; pass if a single mark is used only where all included functions are approved and conditions 3.3.6.1.1–3.3.6.1.2 are met.
quote: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed. This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that:

sentence: It is visible after their installation.
text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the marking shall be visible after their installation.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined rear lamp and retro-reflector.
test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle; pass if the single approval mark is visible.
quote: It is visible after their installation.

sentence: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined rear lamp and retro-reflector.
test_case: Attempt to detach each light-transmitting part (lens, retro-reflector); pass if none can be removed without also removing the approval mark/UI.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.

sentence: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined rear lamp and retro-reflector.
test_case: Measure the mark components; pass if each is at least the minimum size of the smallest individual mark required by the pertinent regulations.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

sentence: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
text: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
test_case: Test production samples against paragraphs 4 and 5; pass if they meet the requirements and match the approved type.
quote: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.

sentence: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 shall be complied with.
text: For retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation, the minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 shall be complied with.
test_case: Audit the manufacturer's CoP control procedures; pass if they meet Annex 2 minimum requirements.
quote: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 shall be complied with.

sentence: The minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 3 shall be complied with.
text: For retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation, the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 3 shall be complied with.
test_case: Verify inspector sampling results per Annex 3; pass if samples meet Annex 3 criteria.
quote: The minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 3 shall be complied with.

sentence: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
test_case: Review the retro-reflector against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at application; pass if all feasible provisions are met.
quote: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.

sentence: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
test_case: Check the R48 requirements pertinent to a rear retro-reflector on M1 vehicles that are verifiable at device approval; pass if all are met.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.

sentence: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
test_case: Inspect construction and verify photometric performance before and after the Annex test sequence; pass if it functions satisfactorily throughout.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

sentence: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
test_case: Visually inspect samples for design or manufacturing defects; pass if none detrimental to operation or maintenance are found.
quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.

sentence: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector components by hand without tools; pass if they cannot be easily dismantled.
quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

sentence: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
test_case: Inspect and wipe the outer surface; pass if it can be cleaned easily.
quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

sentence: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
test_case: Inspect the outer surface for roughness and protuberances; pass if smooth and protuberances do not hinder cleaning.
quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

sentence: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; pass if the inner (prism) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.
quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

sentence: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
text: The combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
condition: The retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter (e.g. red lens acting as filter).
test_case: Attempt to separate the optical unit and filter under normal use conditions; pass if they cannot be separated.
quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

sentence: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish shall not be permitted.
test_case: Check BOM and inspect the retro-reflector; pass if colour is obtained by mass-tinted material and not by paint or varnish.
quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.

sentence: These specifications shall apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices
text: The night time colour test specifications shall apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices.
test_case: Confirm the retro-reflector colour is white, red or amber so that night time colour testing applies.
quote: These specifications shall apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices

sentence: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of retro-reflected light under Illuminant A; pass if x,y lie within the R48 night-time red limits.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

sentence: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
test_case: Set up colour test with CIE Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0° (or Annex 4 angle); pass if test conditions are as specified.
quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.

sentence: White retro-reflective devices must not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" used to illuminate the retro-reflective device must not undergo a change of more than 0.01 after reflection by the retro-reflective device.
text: White retro-reflective devices shall not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" used to illuminate the retro-reflective device shall not undergo a change of more than 0.01 after reflection by the retro-reflective device.
condition: The retro-reflector is white (colour not stated; rear retro-reflectors are normally red).
test_case: Measure x,y of Illuminant A before and after reflection; pass if change is not more than 0.01.
quote: White retro-reflective devices must not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" used to illuminate the retro-reflective device must not undergo a change of more than 0.01 after reflection by the retro-reflective device.

sentence: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5; and
text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
test_case: Measure retro-reflector dimensions and shape against Annex 5; pass if compliant (e.g. non-triangular shape).
quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5; and

sentence: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.; and
text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
test_case: Measure CIL and colour per paragraphs 5.1.4 to 5.1.5; pass if all values meet the specified limits.
quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.; and

sentence: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
test_case: Run the paragraph 5.1.7 physical/mechanical test sequence on samples; pass if all requirements are met.
quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.

sentence: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of retro-reflectors of the Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6.
test_case: Subject ten samples to the Annex 6 Part 1 heat resistance test after general and dimensional checks; pass if samples show no deformation and proceed to optical checks.
quote: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

sentence: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
text: At least one hour after the heat resistance test, the ten samples of retro-reflectors of the Classes IA and IB shall be examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
test_case: Measure colour and RI at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° at least 1 h after heat test; pass if values meet paragraphs 5.1.5 and 5.1.4.
quote: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

sentence: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
test_case: Perform full RI measurement per paragraph 5.1.4 on the min and max samples; pass if all Table 3 values are met.
quote: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.

sentence: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
text: The two samples of the first group shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
test_case: Run Annex 6 Part 2 water penetration test then Annex 7 Parts 1 and 2 fuel/lubricant tests on two samples; pass if no water ingress and no surface damage.
quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).

sentence: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
text: The two samples of the second group shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.

quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.

sentence: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
text: The two samples of the third group shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.

quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.

sentence: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
text: The two samples of the fourth group shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
test_case: Run the Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test on two samples; pass if subsequent colour and RI checks are met.
quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).

sentence: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have: A colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.

quote: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have: A colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.

sentence: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.

quote: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.

sentence: The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
text: The verification of the RI of the retro-reflectors after undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1. shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

quote: The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

sentence: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.
text: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.

quote: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.

sentence: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
text: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
