sentence: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI.
condition: The retro-reflector is not marked "TOP".
test_case: Rotate the device about its reference axis at β1 = β2 = 0° and 20' divergence and identify the position of minimum RI.
quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.

sentence: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the RI of retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the rotation about their axes ±5°.
condition: The retro-reflector is marked "TOP".
test_case: Record RI throughout the ±5° rotation; pass if RI never falls below the prescribed value.
quote: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.

sentence: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.
condition: The retro-reflector is marked "TOP".
test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked device ±5° about its axis at β1 = β2 = 0° and 20' divergence while measuring RI.
quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.

sentence: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
test_case: Check RI at β1 = β2 = 0°, ε = 0°; if ≥150 per cent of the specified value, verify all measurements are made at ε = 0° and meet the specified values.
quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.

sentence: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.
text: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.
test_case: Review the test report to confirm angles are specified and measured in the CIE angular system of Figure A4-I.
quote: The CIE-angular system as shown in Figure A4-I shall be used for specifying and measuring retro-reflective device and marking materials.

sentence: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
test_case: Confirm the test report states illumination with CIE Standard Illuminant A and measurement per Annex 4 Part 1.
quote: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.

sentence: The measuring geometry is described in Figure A4-III. The following limits apply: Angular diameter of the source -δ≤10'
text: For the measuring geometry described in Figure A4-III, the angular diameter of the source shall be δ≤10'.
test_case: Check the test setup: angular diameter of the source ≤10'.
quote: The measuring geometry is described in Figure A4-III. The following limits apply: Angular diameter of the source -δ≤10'

sentence: The measuring geometry is described in Figure A4-III. The following limits apply: Angular diameter of the measuring device -γ≤10'
text: For the measuring geometry described in Figure A4-III, the angular diameter of the measuring device shall be γ≤10'.
test_case: Check the test setup: angular diameter of the measuring device ≤10'.
quote: The measuring geometry is described in Figure A4-III. The following limits apply: Angular diameter of the measuring device -γ≤10'

sentence: The measuring geometry is described in Figure A4-III. The following limits apply: Angular diameter of the illuminated area -η≤80'
text: For the measuring geometry described in Figure A4-III, the angular diameter of the illuminated area shall be η≤80'.
test_case: Check the test setup: angular diameter of the illuminated area ≤80'.
quote: The measuring geometry is described in Figure A4-III. The following limits apply: Angular diameter of the illuminated area -η≤80'

sentence: During photometric measurements, stray reflections should be avoided by appropriate masking.
text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections should be avoided by appropriate masking.
test_case: Confirm appropriate masking is used during photometric measurements to avoid stray reflections.
quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections should be avoided by appropriate masking.

sentence: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above and illustrated in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
text: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above and illustrated in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
test_case: Verify the measuring distance is at least 10 m and respects the δ, γ and η limits.
quote: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above and illustrated in Figure A4-III are respected, but not lower than 10 m.

sentence: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light shall be sufficiently uniform.
text: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light shall be sufficiently uniform.
test_case: Map the illuminance across the useful area of the retro-reflector perpendicular to the incident light and confirm it is uniform.
quote: The illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device, measured perpendicular to the incident light shall be sufficiently uniform.

sentence: A check on this condition requires a measuring element, the sensitive area of which is not greater than one-tenth of the area to be examined. The variation in the value of the illuminance shall then comply with the condition: max/min ≤ 1.05
text: When checked with a measuring element, the sensitive area of which is not greater than one-tenth of the area to be examined, the variation in the value of the illuminance over the useful area of the retro-reflective device shall comply with the condition: max/min ≤ 1.05.
test_case: Measure the illuminance with a sensor no larger than one-tenth of the examined area and verify the max/min ratio is ≤ 1.05.
quote: A check on this condition requires a measuring element, the sensitive area of which is not greater than one-tenth of the area to be examined. The variation in the value of the illuminance shall then comply with the condition: max/min ≤ 1.05

sentence: The photometer head shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.
text: The photometer head shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.
test_case: Review the photometer head calibration certificate for V(λ) correction to the CIE photopic observer.
quote: The photometer head shall be corrected to the spectral luminous efficiency for the CIE standard photometric observer in photopic vision.

sentence: The device shall not show a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture; otherwise suitable provisions shall be added, e.g. the application of a diffusing window at a certain distance in front of the sensitive surface.
text: The photometer head shall not show a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture, except that otherwise suitable provisions shall be added, e.g. the application of a diffusing window at a certain distance in front of the sensitive surface.
test_case: Scan the photometer head aperture for local sensitivity variation, or confirm a diffusing window is fitted.
quote: The device shall not show a perceptible change in local sensitivity within the area of its aperture; otherwise suitable provisions shall be added, e.g. the application of a diffusing window at a certain distance in front of the sensitive surface.

sentence: The background to the sample and the framework of the sample holder should be matt black and the field of view of the photometer head and the spread of light from both the sample and the source shall be restricted as much as possible.
text: The field of view of the photometer head and the spread of light from both the sample and the source shall be restricted as much as possible.
test_case: Inspect the test set-up for apertures restricting the photometer field of view and the source and sample light spread.
quote: The background to the sample and the framework of the sample holder should be matt black and the field of view of the photometer head and the spread of light from both the sample and the source shall be restricted as much as possible.

sentence: Reflections from the floor and walls which occur over the relatively long test distances used shall be screened from both the sample and the photometer head by baffles.
text: Reflections from the floor and walls which occur over the relatively long test distances used shall be screened from both the sample and the photometer head by baffles.
test_case: Inspect the photometric range for baffles screening floor and wall reflections from the sample and photometer head.
quote: Reflections from the floor and walls which occur over the relatively long test distances used shall be screened from both the sample and the photometer head by baffles.

sentence: Correction of residual stray light should always be allowed for by measuring it when the sample is covered by an opaque matt black surface, zigzag folded black paper of the same size and shape or a specular black surface suitably oriented with a light trap. This value shall be subtracted from that measured on the retro-reflective device
text: The residual stray light value measured when the sample is covered by an opaque matt black surface, zigzag folded black paper of the same size and shape or a specular black surface suitably oriented with a light trap shall be subtracted from that measured on the retro-reflective device.
test_case: Check the test report shows the stray light measured with the sample covered and subtracted from the retro-reflector reading.
quote: Correction of residual stray light should always be allowed for by measuring it when the sample is covered by an opaque matt black surface, zigzag folded black paper of the same size and shape or a specular black surface suitably oriented with a light trap. This value shall be subtracted from that measured on the retro-reflective device

sentence: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
condition: The retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not yet confirmed).
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m; pass if its shape cannot easily be confused with a triangle.
quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.

sentence: Compliance with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
text: Compliance with the above shape and dimension specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.
condition: The retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not yet confirmed).
test_case: Confirm the test report records a visual inspection of the illuminating surface shape against the Annex 5 shape specifications.
quote: Compliance with the above specifications shall be verified by visual inspection.

sentence: Test procedure in the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not yet confirmed).
test_case: Store the retro-reflector for 48 consecutive hours in a dry oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C and verify the logged temperature and duration.
quote: Test procedure in the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.

sentence: Test procedure in the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, after being kept for 48 consecutive hours at 65 °C ± 2 °C the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not yet confirmed).
test_case: After the heat exposure, cool the sample for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C and verify the logged conditions.
quote: Test procedure in the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.

sentence: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the heat test; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion, especially of the optical component, is visible.
quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.

sentence: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
text: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
test_case: Strip removable parts and immerse the retro-reflector for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface; verify logged conditions.
quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.

sentence: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
text: The water penetration test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
test_case: Repeat the immersion with the device turned 180° so the rear face is under about 20 mm of water; verify orientation and depth.
quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.

sentence: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
text: The retro-reflective devices shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in 25 °C ± 5 °C water; verify logged temperature.
quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

sentence: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
text: After the resistance to water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface after the immersion test; pass if no water has penetrated.
quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

sentence: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the resistance to water penetration test.
test_case: Inspect the device after immersion; fail if water is clearly visible at the reflecting surface.
quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

sentence: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
test_case: Lightly shake off excess water and measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; pass if values meet the criterion in that paragraph.
quote: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

sentence: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.
text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust test shall be applied to retro-reflective devices of the Classes IB and IIIB.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the manufacturer requests the alternative water penetration test procedure
test_case: Confirm from the test report that, where the manufacturer requested the alternative, the moisture test and the dust test of Annex 6 Part 3 were both performed on the Class IB device.
quote: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.

sentence: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
text: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Check the collector measurement in the test record shows a precipitation rate between 2.5 and 4.1 mm/min.
quote: The precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.

sentence: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows:
text: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as specified in paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.5.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Verify the test record contains the initial RI measurement of the mounted sample before the water spray exposure.
quote: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows:

sentence: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.
text: During the water spray test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Inspect the test set-up to confirm no drain hole or opening of the lamp is plugged during the water spray.
quote: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.

sentence: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
text: During the water spray test, drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB, the alternative test procedure is used and the device has drain wicks
test_case: Confirm any drain wicks are fitted in the device during the water spray test.
quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.

sentence: The device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min -1.
text: During the water spray test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Check the recorded platform rotation rate is between 3.5 and 4.5 min-1.
quote: The device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min -1.

sentence: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF during the water spray test.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Verify the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions were operated at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle during the spray test.
quote: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.

sentence: Test duration The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Check the test log shows 12 hours of water spray comprising 12 cycles of 5/55 min.
quote: Test duration The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).

sentence: Drain period The rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
text: After the water spray test, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Confirm a 1 hour drain period with spray and rotation off and the cabinet door closed is recorded.
quote: Drain period The rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.

sentence: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed inside the device, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: After draining, inspect, tap and tilt the device; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.
quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.

sentence: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth and measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1; record and compare with the initial RI.
quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.

sentence: Upon completion of the drain period. The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
text: Upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Visually inspect the lamp interior after the drain period and record any moisture accumulation.
quote: Upon completion of the drain period. The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.

sentence: Dust exposure test procedure A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows:
text: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as specified in paragraphs 2.3.5. and 2.3.6.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Verify the initial RI of the mounted sample is recorded before dust exposure.
quote: Dust exposure test procedure A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as follows:

sentence: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.
text: During the dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Inspect the set-up to confirm no openings of the lamp are plugged during dust exposure.
quote: All drain holes and other openings shall remain open.

sentence: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
text: During the dust exposure test, drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB, the alternative test procedure is used and the device has drain wicks
test_case: Confirm any drain wicks are fitted in the device during dust exposure.
quote: Drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.

sentence: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
text: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Check the dust test log shows agitation of 2 to 15 s every 15 min over 5 hours.
quote: The test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.

sentence: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
text: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Measure the device-to-wall distance in the dust chamber; pass if at least 150 mm.
quote: The mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.

sentence: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
condition: Retro-reflector is Class IB and the alternative test procedure is used
test_case: Clean and dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and compare with the initial RI.
quote: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

sentence: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
test_case: Subject the retro-reflector to the ISO 9227:2017 saline mist test and verify that the photometric and colorimetric values still meet the prescribed limits.
quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.

sentence: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
text: The resistance of the front surface of retro-reflective devices to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
test_case: After the corrosion test, inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear-face protection for deterioration; pass if none impairs function.
quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.

sentence: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
test_case: Verify from the test report that the lamp, stripped of removable parts, was exposed to saline mist for 2 x 24 h with a 2 h drying interval.
quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

sentence: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
text: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
condition: The retro-reflective device has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion.
test_case: Check the test report records a 5 % NaCl solution atomized at 35 °C ± 2 °C with distilled water of ≤ 0.02 % impurities.
quote: In the case of retro-reflective devices with essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.

sentence: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency is visible.
quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

sentence: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and confirm it is within the Table 9 minimum and Table 10 maximum.
quote: The coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.

sentence: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
text: Before measuring the coefficient of retro-reflection after the corrosion test, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.
test_case: Confirm the test record shows the surface was cleaned of salt deposits before the post-corrosion photometric measurement.
quote: Before measuring, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist.

sentence: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
text: In the case of mirror-backed moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA and IB, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
condition: The retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face.
test_case: Verify the test report shows the accessible rear face was brushed with a hard nylon brush.
quote: The reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.

sentence: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
text: After having brushed, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA and IB, the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
condition: The retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face.
test_case: Verify a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture was applied to the rear face for one minute and the device then dried.
quote: After having brushed in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.

sentence: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
text: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side of the mirror-backed retro-reflective device shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
condition: The retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face.
test_case: Verify the rear face was brushed again with the same nylon brush after evaporation was complete.
quote: As soon as evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.

sentence: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
text: The RI of the mirror-backed retro-reflective device shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
condition: The retro-reflector is a mirror-backed moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face.
test_case: Cover the rear face with Indian ink and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; pass if values meet the prescribed requirements.
quote: The RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.

sentence: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1: in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours,
text: In case of retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1 for a period of 500 hours.
condition: Applies only if the resistance to weathering test of Annex 6 is required for the retro-reflector class of the product (class not yet stated).
test_case: Expose retro-reflector samples in a xenon weathering apparatus per EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with Table A6-1 parameters for 500 hours and verify the exposure log shows the full duration.
quote: The samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1: in case of retro-reflective devices for a period of 500 hours,

sentence: TM1 - Black-standard thermometer Cycle No. according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 Exposure period Irradiance Black-standard temperature °C Relative humidity % Broadband (300 to 400 nm) W/m² Narrowband (340 nm) W/m² 1 102 min dry 18 min water spray 60 ± 2 60 ± 2 0.51 ± 0.02 0.51 ± 0.02 65 ± 3 50 ± 10
text: For test method TM1 (Black-standard thermometer), the samples shall be exposed using cycle No. 1 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with an exposure period of 102 min dry and 18 min water spray, an irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), a black-standard temperature of 65 ± 3 °C and a relative humidity of 50 ± 10 per cent, as given in Table A6-1.
condition: Applies only if the weathering test is required for the retro-reflector class and method TM1 is used.
test_case: Check the weathering apparatus settings and log for cycle 1: 102/18 min, 60 ± 2 W/m² (or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² at 340 nm), 65 ± 3 °C BST, 50 ± 10 % RH.
quote: TM1 - Black-standard thermometer Cycle No. according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 Exposure period Irradiance Black-standard temperature °C Relative humidity % Broadband (300 to 400 nm) W/m² Narrowband (340 nm) W/m² 1 102 min dry 18 min water spray 60 ± 2 60 ± 2 0.51 ± 0.02 0.51 ± 0.02 65 ± 3 50 ± 10

sentence: TM2 - Black-panel thermometer Cycle No. according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 Exposure period Irradiance Black-panel temperature °C Relative humidity % Broadband (300 to 400 nm) W/m² Narrowband (340 nm) W/m² 4 102 min dry 18 min water spray 60 ± 2 60 ± 2 0.51 ± 0.02 0.51 ± 0.02 63 ± 3 50 ± 10
text: For test method TM2 (Black-panel thermometer), the samples shall be exposed using cycle No. 4 according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with an exposure period of 102 min dry and 18 min water spray, an irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), a black-panel temperature of 63 ± 3 °C and a relative humidity of 50 ± 10 per cent, as given in Table A6-1.
condition: Applies only if the weathering test is required for the retro-reflector class and method TM2 is used.
test_case: Check the weathering apparatus settings and log for cycle 4: 102/18 min, 60 ± 2 W/m² (or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² at 340 nm), 63 ± 3 °C BPT, 50 ± 10 % RH.
quote: TM2 - Black-panel thermometer Cycle No. according to EN ISO 4892-2:2013 Exposure period Irradiance Black-panel temperature °C Relative humidity % Broadband (300 to 400 nm) W/m² Narrowband (340 nm) W/m² 4 102 min dry 18 min water spray 60 ± 2 60 ± 2 0.51 ± 0.02 0.51 ± 0.02 63 ± 3 50 ± 10

sentence: Preparation of test specimens shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
text: Preparation of test specimens shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
condition: Applies only if the weathering test is required for the retro-reflector class.
test_case: Review specimen preparation records against the general guidelines of EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
quote: Preparation of test specimens shall be in accordance with the general guidelines given in EN ISO 4892-2:2013.

sentence: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either: A retro-reflective device;
text: For resistance to fuels, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for a retro-reflective device.
test_case: Check the fuel-resistance test report confirms the retro-reflector was exposed to a 70/30 vol. per cent n-heptane/toluol mixture.
quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either: A retro-reflective device;

sentence: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
text: After the resistance to fuels test, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
test_case: Visual inspection after the fuel wipe: pass if no apparent surface change is visible other than slight surface cracks.
quote: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.

sentence: (a) The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
text: For resistance to fuels, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface of the retro-reflector with a cotton cloth soaked in the 70/30 n-heptane/toluol mixture and record the procedure.
quote: (a) The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

sentence: (b) After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually.
text: For resistance to fuels, after about five minutes from wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually.
test_case: About five minutes after the fuel wipe, visually inspect the retro-reflector surface and record the observation.
quote: (b) After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually.

sentence: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, after the resistance to lubricating oils test, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not yet confirmed).
test_case: Measure the RI after the oil test per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; pass if it meets the criterion of that paragraph.
quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

sentence: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not yet confirmed).
test_case: Wipe the retro-reflector outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil and record the procedure.
quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.

sentence: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.
text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, after about 5 minutes from wiping with detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB (class not yet confirmed).
test_case: Clean the oiled surface about 5 minutes after the wipe and record the procedure.
quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

sentence: The following approval marking arrangements are given merely as examples and any other arrangement made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation is acceptable.
text: The arrangement of the approval markings shall be made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation, the arrangements of Annex 10 being given merely as examples.
test_case: Review the marking drawing and verify the approval mark arrangement complies with paragraph 3.3. of UN R150.
quote: The following approval marking arrangements are given merely as examples and any other arrangement made in accordance with paragraph 3.3. of this Regulation is acceptable.

sentence: Note: The above approval number must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
text: The approval number shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and verify the approval number is located close to the circle surrounding the letter "E".
quote: Note: The above approval number must be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".

sentence: The digits constituting the approval number must face the same way as the "E".
text: The digits constituting the approval number shall face the same way as the "E".
test_case: Inspect the approval mark and verify the approval number digits have the same orientation as the letter "E".
quote: The digits constituting the approval number must face the same way as the "E".

sentence: The group of symbols indicating the class must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
text: The group of symbols indicating the class shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
test_case: Inspect the approval mark and verify the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle.
quote: The group of symbols indicating the class must be diametrically opposite the approval number.
